subject: Grebe v2 intake — runtime compatibility, temporary version pin ask
messages:
From: Jake Malone <jake@osprey.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Grebe v2 Onboarding — compatibility questions & timeline

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking a look at Grebe v2. We've attached the inference spec and a compact compatibility matrix (grebe-v2-specs.pdf, grebe-compat-matrix.csv). A few quick asks from our side so we can plan the integration window: 

- Can Redwood support Grebe's sliced KV cache pattern (batch-affinity required)?
- Tokenizer: we ship an alternate BPE variant — will that require tokenizer bridging or a model recompile?
- Pinning: Osprey would like a temporary version pin for v2 during our initial canary (2 weeks) to avoid automatic fallback to earlier variants. What is the approval path?

Proposed target for canary start: 2028-06-01. Happy to walk the team through the spec.

Thanks,
Jake Malone
Head of Integrations, Osprey Systems
[attachment: grebe-v2-specs.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: grebe-compat-matrix.csv (csv)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Grebe v2 Onboarding — compatibility questions & timeline

Thanks Jake — and looping in infra and rollout leads.

Karthik / infra: can you review the attached compat matrix and call out any kernel/runtime blockers for the sliced KV + alternate BPE? If there are microcode or tokenizer-bridging steps needed, what is the ETA for a non-blocking workaround?

Marissa / product ops: Osprey is asking for a temporary version pin during their 2-week canary. Can we support a provisional pinning window (and what signals do we require to unpin)? Proposed canary start 2028-06-01.

Laura: please assess telemetry needs for Grebe v2 (token-level drift, perf deltas).

I'll consolidate answers and route an exception for pin approval if needed.

— Priya
Principal Product Manager, Model Intake
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 14:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Grebe v2 Onboarding — compatibility questions & timeline

Priya — quick initial read. Attached a coarse compat matrix with flags and required engineering work: sliced KV pattern will need a small change to routing and cache sharding; alternate BPE tokenization likely needs a shim layer (tokenizer bridging) unless Osprey provides a standard tokenizer artifact.

High-level items: 
- Runtime: +2 engineer-weeks to add an opt-in cache affinity mode (non-blocking if we default to conservative batching).
- Tokenizer shim: +1 engineer-week if we can build a bridge; +3 if we need to recompile model artifacts.
- Perf impact: expect +6–10% p99 CPU on host-side for bridging during initial canary.

I attached grebe-compat-matrix.csv with my notes. If Marissa wants a deeper perf run I'll queue a small staging job.

— Karthik
Staff Software Engineer, Inference Runtime
[attachment: grebe-compat-matrix.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Grebe v2 Onboarding — compatibility questions & timeline

Thanks Karthik — that scope seems manageable for a provisional canary. Proposed rollout plan: 

1) Staging validation (May 20–24): Karthik to run tokenizer shim + affinity mode in staging; perf smoke test (small corpus).
2) Canary (Jun 1–14): pin Grebe v2 for Osprey's account only, 50 qps cap, telemetry dashboards enabled.
3) Decision gate (Jun 14): unpin if signal OK; extend pin + staggered rollout if mitigations needed.

Telemetry/signals required to unpin: <1% generation drift on test prompts, p95 latency within 15% of baseline, no new error class rate >0.5%. Laura to own dashboards.

I drafted a quick canary runbook and attached canary-runbook.md. For the temporary pin ask, we'll need an exception ticket: summary, risk, rollback plan, and owner. Vivek — can you approve an exception for a 2-week pin (account-scoped) if infra and telemetry sign off?

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Product Operations
[attachment: canary-runbook.md (md)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jake Malone <jake@osprey.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Grebe v2 Onboarding — runtime compatibility, temporary version pin ask (final)

Vivek — short summary and request: 

- External: Osprey Systems requests a 2-week account-scoped version pin for Grebe v2 during their canary (Jun 1–14).
- Risk: moderate; infra estimates +2 engineer-weeks and potential +6–10% host CPU during shim.
- Controls: account-scoped pin, 50 qps cap, telemetry thresholds (Marissa/Laura). Immediate rollback to prior variant on any threshold breach.
- Attachments: grebe-v2-specs.pdf, grebe-compat-matrix.csv, canary-runbook.md.

If you approve, I'll file the exception ticket (INF-7890) and schedule the staging validation with Karthik for May 20.

— Priya
Principal Product Manager
Redwood Inference
